result.instructions: Tools for Trustmary, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which review sources do we have connected, and what are they called?"; "List the responses to our latest customer survey, newest first."; "Add jane@example.com as a customer contact with her company name.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Trustmary data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run trustmary_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run trustmary_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run trustmary_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. trustmary_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: trustmary_test_api_key
tools.title: Test the API key
tools.description: Check that the Trustmary API key works. Returns the organization id, organization name and key name. Trustmary API: GET /test.

tools.name: trustmary_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts of the organization. Filter by e-mail address, or set includeAll to include all contacts. Trustmary API: GET /contacts.

email.description: Only the contact with this e-mail address.

includeAll.description: true = include contacts that are not active.

tools.name: trustmary_list_contact_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List the contact lists of the organization. Use the list ids with the contact tools. Trustmary API: GET /lists.

tools.name: trustmary_upsert_contact
tools.title: Create or update a contact
tools.description: Create a contact, or update it when a contact with the same e-mail address exists. This does not add the contact to a list, so no survey invite is sent. Trustmary API: POST /contacts.

email.description: E-mail address; it identifies the contact.

eid.description: Your own external id for the contact.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field code. Sent as field_<code> (codes from trustmary_list_custom_fields).

tools.name: trustmary_list_surveys
tools.title: List surveys
tools.description: List the surveys of the organization, filterable by type (customer or employee). Trustmary API: GET /surveys.

tools.name: trustmary_get_survey
tools.title: Get a survey
tools.description: Get one survey by id. Trustmary API: GET /survey/{surveyId}.

tools.name: trustmary_list_survey_responses
tools.title: List survey responses
tools.description: List the responses to a survey, newest or oldest first. Use offset and limit to page through them. Trustmary API: GET /survey/{survey_id}/responses.

status.description: Response status to filter by (default: completed).

tools.name: trustmary_get_survey_import_fields
tools.title: Get survey import fields
tools.description: List the fields a survey accepts for imported answers, with their types. Trustmary API: GET /survey/{surveyId}/import-fields.

tools.name: trustmary_import_survey_answers
tools.title: Import survey answers
tools.description: Import answer rows into a survey from another system. Each row needs external_id (an idempotency key: a repeated external_id updates that row) and created_at. Needs the survey-answers import feature on the organization. Trustmary API: POST /survey/{surveyId}/import.

rows.description: Answer rows. Use trustmary_get_survey_import_fields for the field names.

createContacts.description: Create contacts that do not exist yet.

createMissingOptions.description: Create answer options that do not exist yet.

createReviews.description: Create reviews from the imported answers.

tools.name: trustmary_list_import_sources
tools.title: List import sources
tools.description: List the import sources the organization can use for survey answer imports. Trustmary API: GET /import-sources.

tools.name: trustmary_get_import_source
tools.title: Get an import source
tools.description: Get one import source by id. Trustmary API: GET /import-sources/{sourceId}.

tools.name: trustmary_list_embeds
tools.title: List embeds
tools.description: List the embeds owned by the API key holder. Trustmary API: GET /embeds.

tools.name: trustmary_list_widgets
tools.title: List widgets
tools.description: List the widgets owned by the API key holder. Trustmary API: GET /widgets.

tools.name: trustmary_list_experiments
tools.title: List experiments
tools.description: List the experiments owned by the API key holder. Trustmary API: GET /experiments.

tools.name: trustmary_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks of the organization. Trustmary API: GET /webhooks.

tools.name: trustmary_get_webhook_example
tools.title: Get a webhook example payload
tools.description: Get an example of the payload Trustmary sends to a webhook. Trustmary API: GET /webhooks/example.

tools.name: trustmary_create_webhook
tools.title: Create a webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook that sends Trustmary events to a URL you control. Events and their payloads include customer data. Trustmary API: POST /webhooks.

hookUrl.description: The HTTPS URL that receives the events.

tools.name: trustmary_list_review_connections
tools.title: List review connections
tools.description: List the review connections of the organization (the review sources that feed reviews in). Trustmary API: GET /review-connections.

tools.name: trustmary_get_review_connection
tools.title: Get a review connection
tools.description: Get one review connection by its id or slug. Trustmary API: GET /review-connections/{idOrSlug}.

id_or_slug.description: The review connection id or slug.

tools.name: trustmary_create_review_connection
tools.title: Create a review connection
tools.description: Create a review connection. Give targetUrl (a review page URL), or source and targetId (with targetUrl), or search (a Google Places search). Trustmary API: POST /review-connections.

slug.description: A unique slug for the connection.

title.description: A unique title for the connection.

targetId.description: The target id at the review source (used with source).

search.description: A Google Places search text (instead of a URL or id).

tools.name: trustmary_update_review_connection
tools.title: Update a review connection
tools.description: Change the slug or the title of a review connection. Trustmary API: PATCH /review-connections/{idOrSlug}.

id_or_slug.description: The review connection id or slug.

slug.description: New slug, or null to unset it.

title.description: New title, or null to unset it.

tools.name: trustmary_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the custom fields of the organization, optionally for one entity (for example contacts). Trustmary API: GET /fields.

entity.description: Entity the fields belong to, for example contact.

tools.name: trustmary_get_custom_field
tools.title: Get a custom field
tools.description: Get one custom field by id. Trustmary API: GET /fields/{field_id}.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Trustmary
prompts.description: What you can do with Trustmary here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_the_connected_review_sources
prompts.title: Check the connected review sources
prompts.description: List the review connections, which are the review sources that feed reviews in. Open one by its id or slug.

prompts.name: read_the_responses_to_a_survey
prompts.title: Read the responses to a survey
prompts.description: List the customer or employee surveys. Page through the responses to one survey, newest or oldest first.

prompts.name: look_up_or_create_a_customer_contact
prompts.title: Look up or create a customer contact
prompts.description: Look up contacts by e-mail address. Create a contact, or update it when the e-mail address exists. The contact is not added to a list, so no survey invite is sent.

prompts.name: import_survey_answers_from_another_system
prompts.title: Import survey answers from another system
prompts.description: Read the import fields of a survey, then import answer rows. A repeated external_id updates that row. The organization needs the survey-answers import feature.

prompts.name: set_up_a_webhook_to_a_url_you_control
prompts.title: Set up a webhook to a URL you control
prompts.description: List the webhooks and read an example payload. Then create a webhook that sends events to your URL. Events include customer data.
